comment: bones.c savebones():620 update_mlstmv() stamps every monster on the bones level with the dying game's turn (dog.c set_mon_lastmove()) after the loop at bones.c:541-549 has zeroed mlstmv and made the pet hostile. A loading game compares that stamp with its own svm.moves: dogmove.c dog_move():1157-1164 lets a pet's victim strike back only when the victim's mlstmv is not this turn. A human Healer in debug mode with a kitten searches twice and kills herself with a wished-for wand of death on turn 3, then saves bones on level 1. The second game answers y to 'Get bones?' (keeping the file) and starts on that level beside the old kitten; on turn 3 the new kitten bites the old one, which, stamped with turn 3, does not bite back. The number of searches in the first game was chosen by trying 1 to 12; only 2 put a bite on the stamped turn. Seeds, dates and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
